jobDescription: A design-collaboration tool for small agencies converts free sign-ups into paid workspaces. The Product Manager for onboarding owns the first-week experience, runs onboarding experiments with the data analyst, interviews new users every month and works with the lifecycle-marketing team on the welcome emails. The hiring panel decides on applicants after reading a neutral evidence summary. Around 40,000 people sign up each month, and about one workspace in twelve becomes a paying account within 30 days. The onboarding product manager works with a squad of five engineers and a designer, reports to the head of product and shares a quarterly plan with the growth and lifecycle-marketing leads. Experiments run on the company's feature-flag platform, and every test needs a written brief before it starts.
requirements: Has managed onboarding for a product sold to agencies or other professional-services firms.
Owns the onboarding roadmap and sets its success metrics.
Designs and runs onboarding experiments with a data analyst.
Interviews new users regularly and shares findings with the team.
Works with lifecycle marketing on onboarding emails.

evidence.text: Owned the onboarding roadmap at Pixelcraft, a whiteboard app, with activation defined as a user inviting a teammate and creating a board within seven days.
Designed four onboarding experiments with the data analyst, writing the hypothesis, the variants and the stopping rule for each before launch.
Interviewed six to eight new users every month and posted a summary of the findings in the team channel with clips from the recordings.
Reviewed the welcome-email sequence with the lifecycle-marketing manager and changed the second email to link to the template gallery.
Pixelcraft's paying customers were mainly schools and small businesses; agency accounts made up a small share.

Work sample: the experiment brief and readout for the 'invite a teammate' checklist test: hypothesis, two variants, the pre-set stopping rule, activation of 31.4% in control against 34.9% in the variant over 21 days, and the head of product's decision to ship.
HR verification note: employment at Pixelcraft from June 2021 to the present as Product Manager, checked against the employer's confirmation of employment.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate prefers a video call for the first panel and is available from the start of next month.
